caption: The drawing features three ballet-type shoes arranged vertically on a plain, off-white background. The top shoe is purple with a slight sheen and has two light beige ribbons attached, crisscrossed loosely over the shoe. The middle shoe is red with a lighter red inner lining, and it has no visible ribbons but has decorative scalloped edges along the upper rim. The bottom shoe is black with a light beige inner lining, and it features black ribbons crossing over the shoe, as well as a small bow or knot detail near the toe. To the left of each shoe, there are corresponding outline sketches, each showing a top-down silhouette of the shoe above which they are placed, with the top one in gray, the middle one outlined in light red, and the bottom one in dark gray. The objects are drawn with colored pencils, and the composition is symmetrical, with the shoes centered and the outlines aligned vertically to their left.
title: Slippers
